svg.title: tx.wrap: commit and rollback conditions
svg.desc: Any normal callback return, including an unchecked failed HaiResult, enters commit. A throw enters rollback; commit/rollback failures must also be handled. The transaction covers its database operations, not messages, payments or file uploads in other systems.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
